threshold.description: N. A page requires a PROVEN crossing: delta >= m*(N-1)+1 over an interval of m=ceil(period/window) windows (research R-05, FR-004). Default 3.

window_seconds.description: Threshold window. Default 900. Retention of candidate baselines is 4x this.

quiet_ticks_to_clear.description: K: consecutive no-rise ticks before a cleared entry (FR-008). Default 2.

ignore.description: Units/containers that never raise a crash-loop alert (FR-002). Exact match on UnitKey; unique; reason required.

max_alerts_per_tick.description: Individual crash-loop notifications per tick; all remaining events fold into one bounded aggregate alert (research R-15). Default 3.

read_budget_seconds.description: Monotonic deadline for reading all three scopes (research R-15). Default 6.
